verdict.rationale: Gide's own Venture & Growth Tech page says it supports growth companies 'from fundraising to exit'. It has a dedicated Mergers and acquisitions section with a named exit deal (Comeen's acquisition by LumApps) and says it advises on financing transactions 'from seed capital to IPOs', backed by a Chambers Band 1 VC ranking. Public-offering experience appears only as the end of the financing range, with no IPO deal references. Missing for 10: documented IPO/public-offering deal references for venture-backed companies, more than one named M&A exit reference, independent corroboration of exit work.

support.subject: As a founder, the firm can carry the company through to exit — M&A and public-offering experience for venture-backed companies is documented on its own pages

citations.quote: at all stages of a growth company's development, from fundraising to exit.
